description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAbstractDispatcher' that implements the 'LocalDispatcher' interface. It provides methods for scheduling services, managing transaction boundaries, and registering rollback and commit services within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericAbstractDispatcher
classes.description: An abstract class implementing service dispatching, scheduling, and transaction management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of this dispatcher.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service with specified parameters, handling transaction boundaries and job management.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a rollback service to be executed if the current transaction rolls back.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Registers a commit service to be executed after successful transaction commit.

methods.name: getJobManager
methods.description: Returns the JobManager instance from the dispatcher.

methods.name: getJMSListeneFactory
methods.description: Returns the JMS Listener Factory from the dispatcher.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance from the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security instance from the dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this dispatcher.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters this dispatcher from the ServiceContainer and removes it from cache.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific service.
